material.description: CI job 'workspace tests' fails on origin f9cb36ce (run 40115318473, job 120935287450; ci-status dispatch 1792862403327-5043-49e170a6a7514250) and on a8e293e808c3136a9ed5482d3d46bd0b08fec8e0 (run 40115345036, job 120935362405; ci-log dispatch 1792862350212-5008-67415602b5d01a3b). Panic: crates/mod-host/tests/panels_route.rs:54:5, test hud_and_lobby_are_sent_on_the_first_refresh expects the hud to show 'gold 625' and the pre-match clock. The last green origin tip is 02c918bc (ci-status 3/3 success), so the regression is among the 8 commits between 02c918bc and f9cb36ce, which touch js/client/hud.js, js/client/play.js, js/client/render3d.js, js/client/ui_minimap.js, scenarios/moba/panels.lua and scenarios/moba/moba_ui.json. Clearing action: the owner of that commit restores the hud/lobby first-refresh payload, then ci-status on the new sha is green. Not caused by the doodad change in a8e293e8 (its parent f9cb36ce is equally red). Found by content-ytpb-pathblocker-placed-as-props (drain-ytpb-1).

notes.note: drain-gui-controls-1: still red on the publishes of this lane: 5129a34c (run 40115296322), 3292a7ca, 5204edb9, 92323b66 and aafb0929 (parent 4c241872 also failing). Same test: hud_and_lobby_are_sent_on_the_first_refresh FAILED in the rust workspace tests job (mod-host). The JS-only publishes do not touch it.
